term: dependence, source and warrant across regress domains
resolution: Graph dependence records only directed structure. Efficient per se dependence, respect-indexed mover dependence, metaphysical fact grounding, reason/existence-fact explanation, strict parthood, and all-premise inferential warrant remain different typed relations. A relative source means respectively absence of that chosen relation, not one universal absolute foundation. GeneratedWarrant requires every premise of an inference, while FinitelyGroundedPower is used only for structural path/fixed-point mathematics. The cross-domain model stipulates ontological existence and local activity, withholds justified, and derives failure of GeneratedWarrant; none supplies metaphysical possibility or an epistemic-to-causal bridge. Temporal succession is not equated with all-borrowed per se efficient power.
